title: Native app-owned data location registry without relocation authority
summary: Versioned relative storage class/owner manifest with native OS path binding, external runtime read-only classification, corruption-preserving tests, and no migration grants. Native Windows readiness gate now waits for diagnostics, SQLite vault and registry; existing detailed checks preserved, pending CI.
migration_notes: New versioned manifest; refuses unknown existing files; no user-folder relocation or previous data deletion.
